notes:
Summary: mid-size insurtech evaluating private inference for claims automation + chat support. Strong security appetite (VPC/KMS/data residency). Primary blocker is economics — POC shows accuracy acceptable but costs project above ROI threshold.

Key quotes: "Nice performance but we can't get past the run-rate — GPU+token math doesn't pencil against our current provider" (VP Eng).
"Procurement put a full hiring freeze on new infra commits until FY26 Q3" (Head of IT).

What we did: short POC (8 weeks) on mpt-advanced variant in dedicated with KV caching. Measured token egress and latency. Presented run-rate scenarios (baseline, optimistic caching, heavy quantization). Customer rejected baseline and optimistic still above their internal threshold.

Price pressure specifics: they require ~60-70% unit-cost reduction vs our hosted baseline to consider a 12–24 month commit. Their model: high-throughput low-latency chat for claims triage (avg prompt+response 320 tokens) — cost sensitivity driven by expected 1.2M monthly tokens. Also worried about peak-hour GPU concurrency costs and minimum committed pool size.

Procurement posture: actively evaluating 3 vendors. Competitive notes show Anthropic pitched lower token rates for committed tier; OpenAI proposed a hybrid approach with caching + serverless endpoints. Halloway's internal champion (Sr ML Eng) left in Dec — successor is conservative and risk-averse.

Sales shorthand: stalled since 2026-01. AE tried revised pricing (smaller commit + tiered autoscale) but procurement declined — "not enough savings to justify migration". Security OK with our controls but economics override.

Next actions: archive for now, schedule re-touch in 2026-08 after budget cycle. Consider a two-pronged offer: 1) micro-commit pilot (3 months, constrained qps) with clear acceptance metrics; 2) cost-sharing migration credit for first 6 months.
